notes.title: New Update and Bugfixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Features & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Introducing Progressive Night Difficulty: Enemies now become stronger each night, requiring better defense strategies!
[*]Updated B-Coin Dungeon System:
    - Completely redesigned dungeon appearance and mechanics
    - Added new chest in Dungeon (includes both normal and mimic variants)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed miner work type 1 issues
[*]Fixed inventory interaction problems when option 4 is selected:
    - Items can now be properly added to bags
    - Items can now be placed in chests
    - Items can now be placed in crushers
[*]Fixed AI units not being removed from lists after death
[*]Fixed array errors for Wizard, Builder, and Farmer units
[*]Fixed errors occurring on player death
[*]Fixed items being collected and deleted when inventory is full
[*]Fixed leveling issues for Wizard and Turret AI units
[*]Fixed Turret AI shooting problems
[*]Removed "Z" key bug
[*]Fixed dungeon reset error
[/list]

[h2]The New Dungeon[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344622/7f8eb423d024446215c4fc75d778fce762c8ea77.png[/img]

Note: If you encounter any errors, we recommend starting a new save file first. If the issue persists after trying a fresh save, please report it to me. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: SurvAIval Update - Mar 11 2025
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]  

[h2]New Features[/h2]  
[b]Crusher Improvements[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Added Black List functionality  
[*] Created preset options for Black List  
[*] Added lock button to Crusher and Crate interface  
[*] Added auto-consume mode for nearby items when there are too many items  
[/list]  
[b]Coin System[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Implemented coin merging system  
[/list]  
[b]Item Management[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Added "item remover" button that appears when total item count is too high  
[/list]  
[b]AI Improvements[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Added new working modes for Miner and Gatherer classes  
[*] Added interface to control AI working modes  
[*] New Miner modes:  

  [list]  
  [*] Wander mode  
  [*] Base Mining mode  
  [/list]  
[*] New Gatherer modes:  

  [list]  
  [*] Collector mode  
  [*] Crafter mode  
  [/list]  
[*] Added animal hunting capability to:  

  [list]  
  [*] Warrior class  
  [*] Hunter class  
  [*] Keeper class  
  [*] Wizard class  
  [*] Turret class  
  [/list]  
[*] Builders can now pick up items from the ground  
[*] Miners now indicate when they can't find anything to mine  
[/list]  
[h2]Updates[/h2]  
[b]Inventory System[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Increased inventory slot count  
[*] Increased total item stack count  
[/list]  
[b]Visual Improvements[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Enhanced upgrade indicator for AIs (added upward arrow indicators)  
[*] Made lock button indicator more visible  
[*] Added hover effects to all clickable elements  
[*] Updated FPS counter position  
[/list]  
[b]AI Improvements[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Rebalanced AI XP gain rate  
[*] Redesigned Gatherer AI working logic to comply with black list  
[/list]  
[b]Quality of Life[/b]  
[list]  
[*] Chests can now be opened with empty hands  
[/list]  
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed FPS issues caused by high item counts  
[*] Fixed AI freezing bug where they would sometimes stay idle indefinitely  
[*] Fixed chicken sound bug  
[*] Fixed AI not saving during save process  
[*] Fixed AI count issue when changing classes  
[*] Fixed visual glitches in slider movements  
[*] Fixed non-working "X" (close buttons)  
[*] Fixed right-click locking mechanism for Crusher, Crate, and Spawner  
[*] Fixed bugs related to Wizard class  
[*] Fixed bugs related to Druid class  
[/list]  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391060/
